purpose: Four stage-specific transparent illustrations for the Services page's 2×2 process grid.

export.method: Trim transparent margins, normalize square padding, export alpha-preserving responsive WebP.

images.title: Pain Points / Goals
images.context: Listen to the client and map needs, constraints, budget and schedule.
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one high-definition transparent illustration for a four-stage architectural services process grid.
Reference image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its tactile architectural maquette materials, muted palette, soft professional miniature-render finish and isometric camera. Create the new subject described below; do not reproduce the reference scene.
Context: Kadanglabo, a Yogyakarta architecture studio, works from client needs through contextual site analysis and creative design to buildable working documents and site assistance.
Art direction: refined matte clay and paper architectural miniature, isometric three-quarter view, soft upper-left studio light. Off-white plaster #F3F0EA, warm stone #E6E0D4, muted navy #3C4C74 and terracotta orange #EC6434; natural skin and hair colors where people appear. Restrained, legible, clean and professional. Compact cluster of large meaningful shapes. Center the whole cluster in a square composition with 10% clear padding around it. Full objects visible, no cut-off edges.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including empty spaces within objects. No solid background, no gradient backdrop, no large floor plane and no vignette; this must work on a dark navy website.
Output: one illustration only, high-definition square, ideally 1536x1536. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Floor-plan linework without text is allowed. Avoid decorative clutter, floating text labels, bright blue/green/yellow, icons from unrelated industries.
Subject: an Indonesian architect in a navy overshirt and one adult Indonesian client in a terracotta top discussing a project around a small round warm-stone table. They gesture calmly toward a simple ivory house maquette and a clean brief sheet with abstract navy check marks only, no writing. Beside the brief are a small muted terracotta calendar board with a blank geometric grid and a closed navy portfolio, representing priorities, budget and schedule. Exactly two people, two simple chairs, one small table. Focus on the conversation and agreed requirements; no construction site, no presentation wall.

Subject: a beautifully crafted square architectural SITE ANALYSIS maquette. Three warm ivory stepped contour layers form a small sloped terrain with a rectangular terracotta building footprint, two simplified warm-stone trees and a thin muted navy watercourse along one edge. Above the site, one restrained orange sun disc and a thin curved sun-path arc indicate solar orientation; one small ivory surveying tripod with navy instrument stands at the rear edge. A single rolled survey sheet with navy contour linework rests beside the maquette. Emphasize topography, orientation and environmental context. No people, no completed house, no maps with labels, no futuristic dashboard. Everything reads as tactile physical miniature study objects.

Subject: a clear EXPLODED architectural house maquette as a design study. A warm ivory ground-floor spatial plan sits on a small square stone plinth; one light ivory upper volume hovers directly above its supporting walls, and a simple terracotta roof plane hovers above that, carefully aligned so the design layers are easy to understand. A navy geometric floor-plan sheet, a straightedge and two large stone/terracotta material sample tiles lie beside the model. Architectural surfaces have refined tactile texture, clean lines and restrained detail. No people, no site equipment. Convey spatial problem solving and developing a coherent design, not a chaotic pile of parts.
